meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: Claude 会作为写作搭档陪你写博客、文章和技术文档：一起搭大纲、查资料并加引用、强化开头 hook、逐段给反馈，同时尽量保留你自己的语气和风格。
howto.when: 当你要写博客、深度文章或技术文档，需要查资料加引用、改开头 hook、逐段拿反馈时触发。

say.text: 帮我为一篇关于[主题]的文章搭个大纲
say.note: 会先问选题、受众、目标，再给大纲

say.text: 这是我写的开头，帮我把 hook 改得更有吸引力
say.note: 会分析现状并给几个备选开头

say.text: 我刚写完「为什么这很重要」这一节，帮我点评
say.note: 按清晰度、流畅度、证据逐条反馈

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a writing partner for blogs, articles and technical docs: it helps you outline, research and add citations, strengthen hooks, and review each section while keeping your own voice and tone.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, articles or technical documentation, or when you need research with citations, a stronger hook, or section-by-section feedback.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about [topic]
say_en.note: It asks about topic, audience and goal first.

say_en.text: Here's my intro, help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: You get analysis plus alternative openings.

say_en.text: I finished the 'Why This Matters' section, review it
say_en.note: Feedback on clarity, flow and evidence.
